purpose: Catalog units that must be refused at load time: off-schema, or citing what the catalog does not hold. Each base holds one broken unit and is loaded in front of the reference base.

cases.note: A state law outside the closed vocabulary (§4.3) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
An access geometry naming a runtime data structure (N8) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
The opaque type is gone: a value the contract cannot type cannot be rejected — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A window law must declare its span — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: axis 'attention.headz' is not in the catalog
cases.note: A shape citing an axis the catalog does not hold — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A parameter role with no precision rule — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A guard on an argument the contract never declares: a dead guard, the case found in attention.dense before this schema — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A default the enum does not admit — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: effects.reads: 'keys' is not an input port
cases.note: An effect naming no port — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
The file name is the version; the two must agree (§8.2) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

A precision role with a sensitivity outside the closed set is off the grammar; the fixture role is `state.kv_test`, a new identity — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A contract pinning a template version the template does not carry (§4.6) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A contract naming a template the models base does not hold — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: declares model id 'decoder_causal_yarn', the contract says 'something_else'
cases.note: The template's model id and the contract's disagree — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A contract reading an undeclared analysis fact: there is no context namespace; a span is an argument (§4.4) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
An empty partition list is an omission, not a statement: a contract says `none` when no cut preserves meaning (§4.1) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: unit parameter 'expert_weights' is not a slot
cases.note: A sparsity unit naming a slot the contract does not have (§4.5) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
Operations on parameters are derived, never declared (§4.1); a contract declares only state and sequence corrections — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
There is no reference type: an argument is a scalar, an enum or a record (O9.4) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
Presence of a port is present_when, one authority (I2) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A comparison on an optional argument without default outside a present test is undecidable (§4.3) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
One identity carried by two bases with different contents is a conflict, not a choice (V1).

cases.match: is not in the admissible set
cases.note: A precision role's default is admissible — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: policy names 'token', not an input port
cases.note: A sparsity policy names an argument or an input port of the contract — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A base carrying a template contract declares where its templates live (§4.6) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: state 'conv'.w: a sequence.position axis under a window rule
cases.note: A state payload is declared per position (§4.3): the positions of a window are the law's span, not an axis of the payload — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
